//: Single source of truth for the BLE wire contract between the base station (C++/NimBLE) and its clients. Edit this file, then regenerate: python3 gen_ble_protocol.py
//serviceUUID: Compiled-in default for clients that can't read Kconfig. The firmware itself advertises CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_SERVICE_UUID (base_station/components/frontend_bluetooth/Kconfig, same 0xABF0 default) — if that Kconfig value is ever changed for a deployment, update this field too.
//topics: Topics are not listed here: they mirror every entry of metadata.packetTypes (generated as `enum class <enum>`) in <sourceSchema> (path relative to this file, see gen_packets.py). Each entry NAME = value becomes topic BLE_NAME with the same value, characteristic UUID <uuidPrefix><value as 2 hex digits> (e.g. SENSOR_UPDATE = 0x10 -> BLE_SENSOR_UPDATE, AB10) and Swift/Kotlin case name camelCase(NAME) (sensorUpdate). cppInclude is how the generated C++ header includes the generated PacketType header, for the PacketType <-> NotifyByte conversions. swiftType is how the KMP PacketType (FrontendPackets.kt) is named in Swift via Swift Export from swiftModule, for the PacketType <-> NotifyByte/CharacteristicUUID conversions on iOS.
//fragmentHeaderSize: Every fragmented notify/write is prefixed with this many bytes: [0:2) totalLength, [2:4) offset, both little-endian uint16. See BluetoothManager::sendFragmented / handleFragmentedWrite.

manufacturerData.//: Scan-response manufacturer data layout: companyID (2 bytes LE) + build epoch (buildEpochFieldSize bytes LE, unix seconds). See BluetoothManager::populateBuildVersionMfgData.
